biggest_catch: The friend must complete all requirements — deposit at least $500 AND complete 15 debit card transactions within 60 days — before you earn anything.
catches: The Referred Person must deposit at least $500 into the new checking account AND complete 15 debit card transactions (excluding ATM transactions) within 60 days of account opening.
Cap: the Referrer may receive up to $500 in rewards within a calendar year (10 referrals).
Must be age 18 or older; offer valid only for new C&N customers.
C&N employees are ineligible to participate.
Reward bonuses may be reported as income to the IRS.
This offer can be changed or withdrawn at any time without notice.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: C&N (Citizens & Northern Bank) runs a refer-a-friend program on its official page (cnbankpa.com/Personal/Bank/Checking-Accounts/Reward) paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the Referrer earns a $50 reward bonus for each individual referred who registers, opens a new C&N account, and completes the offer requirements.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the Referrer registers for the program and shares the offer link with friends, family, or coworkers; the Referred Person registers via the link, opens a new C&N account, and completes the offer requirements within the time specified.

c4.evidence: Timing: the Referrer receives the reward within 30 days of the Referred Person meeting the qualifications; the reward is deposited into the Referrer's account with the most recent transaction.

eligibility: C&N customers referring new prospective customers; the Referred Person must meet the offer requirements within 60 days of account opening.
notes: C&N is Citizens & Northern Bank (NY/PA). Distinct from any signup-bonus record.
payout_quote: The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a reward bonus for each individual referred (Referred Person) to C&N who registers for the offer, opens a new C&N account, and completes the offer requirements within the time specified in the offer. Personal Checking: To earn a $50 reward bonus, the Referred Person must register by following the link provided in the referral email, via text or social media, open a new C&N personal checking account, and meet the following requirements within 60 days of account opening: Deposit at least $500 into the new checking account, AND Complete fifteen (15) debit card transactions (excluding ATM transactions).

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Reward bonuses may be reported as income to the IRS.

s4.note: Cap: the Referrer may receive up to $500 within a calendar year (10 referrals at $50 each).

s5.note: Offer live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); the offer can be changed or withdrawn at any time without notice.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: the Referrer registers for the program and shares the offer with friends, family, or coworkers.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: register via the referral link, open a new C&N personal checking account, and within 60 days of account opening deposit at least $500 and complete 15 debit card transactions (excluding ATM).

steps: Register for C&N's Refer A Friend program and share your offer link.
Friend registers via the link and opens a new C&N personal checking account.
Friend deposits at least $500 and completes 15 debit card transactions within 60 days.
Your $50 reward bonus is deposited to your C&N account within 30 days of the friend meeting the qualifications.
timing: The Referrer receives the reward within 30 days of the Referred Person meeting the qualifications.
